provenance: Final prepared-first Worker, WSL Linux headless Chromium; 60 requested one-second windows, short screen without UI-contention loop. Not native Windows/device or 600-second evidence.

latency.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/151.0.7922.34 Safari/537.36

latencySampling.policy: Fixed periodic one-second windows spanning the endurance run; all native/callback/continuity counters remain continuous; retain every exclusion

latency.definition: original captured-track reference in independent observer context; source, processor and observer contexts form a DAG; graph-inclusive standard output difference, no graph subtraction

qualification.strictAudibleContinuity: PENDING: zero quanta not classified and human listening unavailable

latency.method: exact 16000-sample/48000-frame producer windows; -300..300ms normalized correlation; reject low energy, peak<0.3, discontinuity, collector drops, and state/output transitions within +/-256 frames; native qualification rejects whole-phase fallback; nearest-rank percentiles

windowExposedHeapProbe.limit: Measurement retains PCM windows and diagnostic arrays; this is not Worker-attributable or whole-process memory qualification.
